question: What is the theme of the Swachhata Hi Seva (SHS) 2025 campaign, which will be celebrated under the ‘Swacchotsav’ initiative?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swacchotsav**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The theme of the Swachhata Hi Seva (SHS) 2025 campaign is Swacchotsav, celebrating cleanliness and community participation.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The ‘Swacchotsav’ initiative is part of the Swachhata Hi Seva (SHS) 2025 campaign and will run from September 17 to October 2.**
 
• The theme of this year’s campaign focuses on merging festive celebrations with environmental responsibility.
 
• The campaign encourages citizens to participate in cleanliness activities and adopt green practices during the festive season.
 
• Focus areas include the elimination of legacy dumpsites and organizing SafaiMitra Suraksha Shivir for community participation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Swachhata Hi Seva (SHS)__

 __
 
• A nationwide initiative aimed at encouraging citizens to engage in cleanliness activities and promote a clean environment.
 
 
 
• SafaiMitra Suraksha Shivir__
 __
 
• A special event to ensure the safety and well-being of sanitation workers and to promote their welfare.
 
 
 
• Legacy Dumpsite Elimination__
 
 
• An initiative to address and eliminate long-standing waste dumpsites to improve the cleanliness and environmental health of urban areas.
